definitions.full: H8367. shathaq [ שָׁתַק ] verb be quiet (late) (Late Hebrew id., be silent ; Aramaic שְׁתֵיק שְׁתַק, , be quiet, silent (compare also שׁקט )); — Qal Imperfect 3masculine singular, of sea הַיָּם יִשְׁתֹּק Jonah 1:11-12 , (followed by מֵעַל ), of quarrel, strife Proverbs 26:30; 3 masculine plural of persons at sea, יִשְׁתֹּ֑קוּ Psa 107:30 .

occurrences.englishText: Then they are glad because it is calm,
For lack of wood a fire goes out.
Then they said to him, “What shall we do to you, that the sea may be calm to us?” For the sea grew more and more stormy.
He said to them, “Take me up, and throw me into the sea. Then the sea will be calm for you; for I know that because of me this great storm is on you.”
